name: Tunnel
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small piece of a burrowing animal’s claw)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Tunnel causes your hands and forearms to thicken and a heavy layer of leathery skin covers them. You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet, but you may only burrow through dirt (not rock), and you may not run while burrowing. The change to your arms has no effect on your combat abilities.
